dialog.agent:
I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.

Your request is blocked on the current account: **Veo is a paid model and isn’t available on your free tier**. Also, the connected tool lists **Veo 3.1**, not Veo 3, and it doesn’t support an exact 5-second duration.

I won’t substitute another model or approve the quoted 80-credit charge. Would you like to revise the model requirement, or keep this on hold until you have paid Veo access?
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
The free-tier request was refused because your account has **insufficient credits**. No clip was generated, and no credits were spent.

I won’t buy credits or try paid settings. You’ll need more available credits before I can create the 5-second clip with rain sounds.
